episodes.title: Gen-X
episodes.creator: Einstei
episodes.description: Gen is an incarnation of demon. Three thousand years ago, a war happened between the god and the demons. Gen was known as General X, leading the demons to rebel against the god as commanded by Lucifer. Gen-X had successfully penetrated god's fortress, the victory was supposed to lie on his side but he somehow cast a spell and caused a big explosion. It was a self-destruct spell to conceal his power and his soul. No one knows the reason Gen-X did it. During the great explosion, some of the gods and demons were transported to the human world. Both then secretly organized a group. The legend was passed down since then in search of the concealed power. It was believed that the soul of Gen-X would revive after 2 millennia...

episodes.title: Sloppy Fight 2

episodes.title: Stick Thief

episodes.description: This movie follows the game of Thief perfectly. Smooth animation, awesome sound track and killer camera angles make this another must see by Henrik Hermans.

episodes.title: Stick War 2 Order Empire Intro
episodes.creator: Jason Whitham(CRAZYJAY) and Winston Zhang - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: "The nation called Order has brought nothing but chaos to our people! Their day of wrath appraoches..." Also available on YouTube:

episodes.title: Stickmen Future Concepts

episodes.description: An amazing new animation from a very talented artist! This is the first part of an action packed story of a stick man invasion! Enjoy!

episodes.title: The Battlefield 3
episodes.creator: Ringfinger
episodes.description: Sticks, tanks, explosions, blood, guns, fighting, mass chaos, you don't really want to watch this do you? It's a total chick flick...

episodes.title: The ComeBack Collab 3

episodes.title: The Desolated: Prologue

episodes.description: 4 Day Competition Entry

episodes.title: The Indestructible Collab
episodes.creator: Stone, Tawnik, and Drifts
episodes.description: The Story: A man called Dave had been captured and imprisoned after committing numerous crimes. The man proved to be indestructible, he escaped the prison and went into the city and began a killing spree. The Competition: The animations in this collab were made for the TLTFT competition. "Indestructible" is round 1 of TLTFT's 3 rounds. The competition is on the Stickpage Forum by -Hawk- with the support of CRAZYJAY and ZuLu. Be sure to check out Indestructible part two below.

episodes.title: The Indestructible Collab 2
episodes.creator: Endo-K and SSJBryando
episodes.description: The Story: A man called Dave had been captured and imprisoned after committing numerous crimes. The man proved to be indestructible, he escaped the prison and went into the city and began a killing spree. The Competition: The animations in this collab were made for the TLTFT competition. "Indestructible" is round 1 of TLTFT's 3 rounds. The competition is on the Stickpage Forum by -Hawk- with the support of CRAZYJAY and ZuLu. Be sure to check out Indestructible part one below.

episodes.title: The Mission
episodes.creator: Armorstick
episodes.description: The Mission heats up when The Boss tries to escape on a motorcycle!

episodes.title: Thief: Rent's Due
episodes.creator: Paul Beattie
episodes.description: Journey into the world of Thief where the nobility live in castles and real men earn a living by cutting purses. You will join Garrett as he attempts to infiltrate a Lord's gem storeroom using only his wits and a quiver full of special arrows! Watch in HD!

episodes.title: Unglued Battle
episodes.creator: Zack and Pure Chi
episodes.description: A non-stop war from start to end with awesome animation, explosions, lasers, and more blood then you could want. This movie is 100% pure goodness. A collaboration animation from Zack and Pure Chi of Blue 2. Could you imagine how much work went into this movie!

episodes.title: War
episodes.creator: Mindistortion.net
episodes.description: A movie about war and how it has happened so many times before. The music is great, really gets in your head, although I don't understand a word they have said. It's a music video about war.

episodes.title: Wicked Negative One
episodes.creator: Henrik Hermans
episodes.description: Indiana Jones meets Pulp Fiction. This is a long load but worth the wait because it is the longest stick movie on Stickpage.

episodes.title: Wrench vs. Ob-bot
episodes.creator: ehlboy
episodes.description: Wrench (ehlboy) takes on Ob-bot (obi rev) in this Round 2 RHG (Rock Hard Gladiator) Battle! May the best animator win!

episodes.title: Xiao Style 2: Lab Shutdown
episodes.creator: Fitzy
episodes.description: Good old school Xiao style animation. It seems like the bad guys just keep coming! But that won't stop our hero. An action packed non-stop fight scene.

episodes.title: Fleeing the Complex
episodes.creator: PuffballsUnited
episodes.description: Henry has Broken the bank, escaped the prison, stolen the diamond and infiltrated the airship. Perhaps the complex known as "The Wall" can hold Henry the Stickman in his biggest adventure yet!

episodes.title: Infiltrating the Airship
episodes.creator: Puffballs United
episodes.description: Now that you've Stolen the Diamond it's time to Infiltrate the Airship!

episodes.title: Stealing the Diamond
episodes.creator: Puffballs United
episodes.description: You've successfully Escaped the Prison; now it's time to make some cash by Stealing the Diamond!

episodes.title: Escaping the Prison
episodes.creator: Puffballs United
episodes.description: Here it is, the sequel to Breaking the Bank! This one's a little different from it's predecessor however. You can actually win! There are three different victorious endings to this game. You can escape the Lame Way, the Sneaky Way, or the Badass Way. See if you can find them all!

episodes.title: Breaking the Bank
episodes.creator: Puffballs United
episodes.description: A very funny stick movie about a poor guy who just can't get it right. Very similar to the spy vs. spy animations. How do you think our hero should Break the Bank? Laser drill, disguise, explosion, wrecking ball, teleporter, or tunnel?

episodes.title: Dual Death Course 2
episodes.creator: Collab Directed By: Terkoiz, stone, Hyun
episodes.description: The first animation of 4day 2012! Dozens of animators; but only a few will survive the course - find out who!

episodes.title: FLLFFL vs Pulse - RHG
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The third animation of 4day 2012! FLLFFL (Terkoiz) takes on Pulse in this RHG battle! May the best animator win!

episodes.title: Final Fantasy Last Mages
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The fourth and final animation of 4day 2012! Inspired by the classic game series Final Fantasy; watch as two of the last mages battle to the death!

episodes.title: Simply Business
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The first of Terkoiz's 4 Day 2011 animations. Meet The Secretary, The Lawyer, The Mediator, and The Client, conducting some old fashioned Business.

episodes.title: Disbalanced
episodes.creator: LuccasBode
episodes.description: The second of Terkoiz's 4 Day 2011 animations. A tribute to Unbalanced and Rebalanced by LuccasBode!

episodes.title: Grafight V
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The third of Terkoiz's 4 Day 2011 animations. It's been seven years but Grafight is finally back! The battle continues with a twist at the end that you won't want to miss!

episodes.title: Top Stick
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The fourth and final of Terkoiz's 4 Day 2011 animations. A grand tribute to the characters and animations that have most inspired Terkoiz over the years.

episodes.title: 4 Day Trailer
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: Get ready - 4 Day 2011 is almost here! On September 30 Stickpage will present four of the most explosive animations of the year... you won't want to miss it!

episodes.title: Shock
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: You can't top this one! Extreme stick fighting animation taken to a new level by the master, Terkoiz. Get ready to be Shocked!

episodes.title: Shock 2
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: You can't top this one! Extreme stick fighting animation taken to a new level by the master, Terkoiz. Get ready to be Shocked!

episodes.title: Shock 3
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The final episode of the Shock series shows us what happens to Mr. Red when he arrives at work for his annual review! See if you can follow the true Mr. Green!

episodes.title: FLLFFL Vs Thunder
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: Some of the best facial expressions you'll ever see on a pair of stick figures! Enjoy the battle, and be careful what you wish for!

episodes.title: Unbalanced
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The best kind of stick figure action, a short download and a long intense battle with many weapons. And when it's time to remove the subject things get really out of control. Some really amazing looking smooth fighting; you will love it!

episodes.title: Failed Containment
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: One of the best stick animators in the world brings you the wide screen fight where one stick can not be contained! Is this the next Xiao? I think SO! WOW!

episodes.title: Mutantationism
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: This is a quick one you will enjoy!

episodes.title: Diablo
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The online game hit Diablo is brought into the stick figure world, it's much better this way don't you think? As I have said before Terkoiz is simply amazing. The winner of the game animation contest here at Stickpage. Congrats!

episodes.title: BYE
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: 60 deaths by 1 man in 5 minutes. You've been warned!

episodes.title: Shock More
episodes.creator: David "Geo" Borja
episodes.description: An amazing Shock tribute that you're going to love!

episodes.title: Shock Tribute
episodes.creator: Jcamelo
episodes.description: A tribute to Terkoiz' Shock series!

episodes.title: League of Legends: Stick Figure Spotlight 2
episodes.creator: Hyun
episodes.description: The second League of Legends spotlight from Hyun! Enjoy watching all of your favourites dominate... as sticks!

episodes.title: League of Legends: Stick Figure Spotlight
episodes.creator: Hyun
episodes.description: An amazing League of Legends tribute; can you spot all the hero cameos?!

episodes.title: Drunken Stick
episodes.creator: Hyun
episodes.description: Remember kids, never interrupt a drunken boxer on a hot summer day after he's had a few cold ones.

episodes.title: RHG Battle 1
episodes.creator: Hyun
episodes.description: Yoyo (Hyun) takes on FLLFFL (Terkoiz) in the first RHG (Rock Hard Gladiator) Battle! May the best animator win!

episodes.description: The first animation of 4day 2012! Dozens of animators; but only a few will survive the course - find out who!

episodes.title: Kill The Spartan
episodes.creator: CRAZYJAY, Supranova, Endo-K, Hyun, Miccool, Drifts, -Hawk-
episodes.description: Kill The Spartan is a choose your death game based on the "Spearton" character from Stickpage's hit game Stick War . Featuring animations from some of Stickpage's most talented members: CRAZYJAY, Supranova, Endo-K, Hyun, Miccool, Drifts, and -Hawk-!

episodes.title: Stick Toss
episodes.creator: Rebellion + Various Artists
episodes.description: Various artists working together in this unique, fast-paced collab!

episodes.title: Unwanted Visitors
episodes.creator: Paul B, Stund, Pluto, Drifts, Hawk
episodes.description: When aliens invade, there is only one warrior who can stop them! The animations in Unwanted Visitors Collaboration were made for the 1st round of 3 of the Stickpage tournament competition on the Stickpage forum.

episodes.title: Unchained
episodes.creator: Paul B, Stund, Drifts, Dannyplatinum, Hawk
episodes.description: It's the slave's turn to lead. The animations in Unchained Collaboration were made for the 2nd round of 3 of the Stickpage Tournament competition on the Stickpage forum.

episodes.title: Ice Cold Greed
episodes.creator: Drifts, Stund, Paul B, Hawk
episodes.description: A desperate hiker's struggle to save a priceless diamond from treasure hunters. The animations in Ice Cold Greed were made for the 3rd round of 3 of the Stickpage Tournament competition on the Stickpage forum.

episodes.title: Castle 2
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: This is one of the best cinematic stick or flash movies to date with over 1283 used in its creation. This has to be one of the top ten stick movies ever made. Very large file size however so grab some drinks and popcorn while it loads, it plays like a movie after all!

episodes.title: Castle 3A
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: Without question the top stick figure movie you can find. Split into part 3A, 3B, 3C, and 3D. The entire movie is quite long and you will love every second. Make sure you have time because I promise you wont stop after just watching one. "After almost two years of hard work I have finally managed to complete the third installment of the Castle series. This is the first part out of four. I hope you enjoy." -Oscar

episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: Without question the top stick figure movie you can find. Split into part 3A, 3B, 3C, and 3D. The entire movie is quite long and you will love every second. Make sure you have time because I promise you wont stop after just watching one. "After almost two years of hard work I have finally managed to complete the third installment of the Castle series. This is the first part two of four. I hope you enjoy." -Oscar

This is the first part three of four. I hope you enjoy." -Oscar

episodes.title: Castle Repercussions A
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: A Private's Dread. The first episode of Castle Repercussions. Made in 2007/2008.

episodes.title: Castle Repercussions B
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: A Bird's Awakening. The second episode of Castle Repercussions. Made in 2007/2008.

episodes.title: Castle Repercussions C
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: The third installment of Castle Repercussions follows Sergeant John Mullins as he fights to survive and locate the other members of his team.

episodes.title: Castle Repercussions D1
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: The fourth and final installment of Castle Repercussions follows Boomer's exciting escape! Be sure to check out the second part of the finale below!

episodes.title: Castle Repercussions D2
episodes.creator: Oscar Johansson
episodes.description: The fourth and final installment of Castle Repercussions follows Boomer's exciting escape! Be sure to check out the first part of the finale below!

episodes.title: Stick Dude Killing Arena Game
episodes.creator: Eric Posas - ESP Animation - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: You're in control when you enter the Stick Dude Killing Arena this time! You'll have access to all the amazing weapons you've seen in the arena before, guns, grenades, molotov cocktails, dragon fist gloves and even a lightsaber!

episodes.title: Stick Dude Killing Arena
episodes.creator: Eric Posas - ESP Animation - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: Enter the Stick Dude Killing Arena, but be warned it's not a friendly place! With all the blood flying around you'd do well to bring goggles (also a machine gun and some grenades wouldn't hurt)!

episodes.title: Stick Dude Killing Arena 2
episodes.creator: Eric Posas - ESP Animation - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: Your second trip to the Stick Dude Killing Arena will be even more exciting than your first! In addition to your usual mayhem and slaughter, Eric has added some amazing slow motion animation to enhance the action!

episodes.title: Stick Dude Killing Arena 3
episodes.creator: Eric Posas - ESP Animation - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: The third Stick Dude Killing Arena looks like a war zone; throughout the animation the bodies keep piling up! Personally I'd man the machine gun, however, those lightsabers look pretty good too...

episodes.title: Stick Dude Killing Arena 4
episodes.creator: Eric Posas - ESP Animation - Stickpage.com
episodes.description: In this extended version of the final Stick Dude Killing Arena you'll be blown away by the 3D special effects Eric's added for us. Be wary of snipers lurking in the distance, even observers aren't safe in this awesome animation!

episodes.title: Madness Combat
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: This the the movie that made Madness Combat into a classic overnight. It's total chaos, violence, and lets not forget madness. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 2: Redeemer
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: Somewhere in Nevada there is one man who is on a mission to track down and kill the sheriff. Things get really funky when it turns out the sheriff has some backup and its not going to be as easy as it seems. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 3: Avenger
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: He was given a second chance, and you know hes going to make the best of it. Somewhere in Nevada, patched up and back, better then ever. Watch the kills pile up in this amazing flash movie. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 4: Apotheosis
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: You would think after the last movie there is no way he's coming back but guess what... heee's baaackk! And so are your other favorite Madness characters. All the graphics have been upgraded and the action is more intense then ever. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 5: Depredation
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: I don't know how he is back this time, really I don't but lets just accept that he is because this is by far the best of the Madness series. It's so out of control you will have to watch it a few times to catch all the action. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 6: Antipathy
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: Krinkels brings us Antipathy! If the movie runs poorly on your machine try switching to low quality. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat 7: Consternation
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: The latest in the Madness Combat series, Consternation! If the movie runs poorly on your machine try switching to low quality. Warning: this movie contains brutal violence.

episodes.title: Madness Combat: Aggregation
episodes.creator: Krinkels
episodes.description: It's a race against time to get Hank back in action; but once he's back he won't be stopped!

episodes.title: Madness Combat Interactive
episodes.creator: Krinkels and Max Abernethy
episodes.description: You have watched the Madness Combat movies, now play the mad fighting game! Use the in game practice mode so you stand a chance.

episodes.title: Maximum Ninja
episodes.creator: Eugene "Stooge" Nesci
episodes.description: Meet Maximum Ninja - a series animated based on the Madness Combat series but with its own very cool feel. Part 2 and Part 3 of this series are five times better then this first one but this will get you into it. I suggest you watch them all because they just keep getting better.

episodes.title: Maximum Ninja 2
episodes.creator: Eugene "Stooge" Nesci
episodes.description: This is five times better then Part 1 and Part 3 is even better! Funny, violent, and AwS0om3!

episodes.title: Maximum Ninja 3
episodes.creator: Eugene "Stooge" Nesci
episodes.description: Movie runs for 8 minutes, and is one of the best movies on Stickpage. Watch it!

episodes.title: Operation: BAD Intro
episodes.creator: CRAZY JAY the Ninja
episodes.description: An intro to a game that I am making, CRAZY JAY the Ninja is back to his old fighting, dancing self. Learn how he got his powers and watch as he uses them! This one's made by me, CRAZY JAY creator of Stickpage.

episodes.title: Operation: Chop-Stick
episodes.creator: CRAZY JAY the Ninja
episodes.description: CRAZY JAY the Ninja, in his first stick movie! This is an oldy but a goody. Don't forget to watch part 2 after this.

episodes.title: Operation: Chop-Stick 2
episodes.creator: CRAZY JAY the Ninja
episodes.description: CRAZY JAY the Ninja, in part 2 of the Operation series. Don't forget to watch part 1 first. Half way through there is a surprise dress up game, have fun!

episodes.title: Operation: Dance Dance
episodes.creator: CRAZY JAY the Ninja
episodes.description: CRAZY JAY the Ninja busts out in some new tricks, Michael Jackson style. "Very fluid dance animation and a sweet soundtrack make this another must-see!" - Tom Fulp of Newgrounds

episodes.title: Flair
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: Flair takes a stroll in the park only to find himself surrounded by ninjas on all sides, will he get out alive? ...Yes. Hehe. There are some nice 3D effects in this movie as well!

episodes.title: Flair 2
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: Flair try's a Xiao-Xiao style movie, and you can see the potential for greatness. Flair kicks ass!

episodes.title: Flair 3
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: Flair takes on the world in this Olympic style fight scene with some of the best stick animations to date!

episodes.title: Flair 4
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: This is my all time favorite stick movie, you will love it watch it! Better than Xiao? You decide!

episodes.title: Flair 5
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: Once again Flair's animation will amaze. This time Flair is fighting for his life, and this get really bad when his girl gets caught in the battle. Could this be the end of Flair? (The rain effects rule!) For English click the English button!

episodes.title: Flair 6
episodes.creator: Flair
episodes.description: A continuation of Part 3's round robin Tournament. Flair lives on!

episodes.title: World War Shock
episodes.creator: Theexceld
episodes.description: Combination of two classic animations with a twist! World War Shock - will red survive?

episodes.title: Apache
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: A very detailed smooth in your face animation that will make you feel like you're at the movies watching a major action flick. Perhaps one of slickest stick animations around. Author's Note: My biggest project to date. I kindly ask that you adjust your quality settings to medium, close your curtains, and turn off the lights before you watch the movie. Thanks to everyone for their support and thanks again for watching the movie.

episodes.title: Shorts Bonanza
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: Warning: this movie is full of blood. Special thanks to Toughluck for this collection of shorts, very creative ways for stick figures to do what they do best.

episodes.title: Shorts Extravaganza
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: Warning: this movie is full of blood. Special thanks to Toughluck for this collection of shorts, another movie full of very creative ways for stick figures to do what they do best.

episodes.title: Shorts Finale
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: The bizarre random series of explosive shorts have finally ended. In this movie 'A Couple of Shorts Finale', you will find 24 shorts that are longer, more bloody, and funnier than ever before. This is the 6th addition to the series.

episodes.title: Taegukigu: Stagnant Fire
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: The most realistic war stick figure movie you will find (real stick men?) hmmm... you know what I mean. Everything from the sound effects to the guns are perfect, you will love it! Author's Note: Stagnant Flame, and Stagnant Fire were inspired and are tributes to Robbie Robertson's Fallen Angel. Please watch Stagnant Flame before watching this movie. I highly recommended that you adjust your quality settings to medium or low before watching the movie.

episodes.title: Taegukigu: Stagnant Flame
episodes.creator: Justin Oh
episodes.description: Toughluck has done it again. If you don't like guns, blood, or action then don't watch this movie! Author's Note: A tribute to 'Fallen Angel'. Cheers to SicStuf for the voice acting. Hope you all enjoy.

episodes.title: World War 2
episodes.creator: Johan Sundkvist
episodes.description: If you're a fan of Saving Private Ryan (who isn't?) or any other war movie for that matter, you will love this. A toon version of world war 2, masterfully done with stick figures.

episodes.title: A Nice Day To Die
episodes.creator: Henrik Hermans
episodes.description: Smooth fighting with some never before seen styles, with a big bang for an ending. What more could you want?

episodes.title: A Nice Day To Die 2
episodes.creator: Henrik Hermans
episodes.description: If you have seen Part 1, you're asking yourself wait! How could there be a sequel? Well there is... and it's great with tons of places for these crazy sticks to fight. This has some great scenes with a lot of hard work put into them.

episodes.title: Nero 2: Determination
episodes.creator: Triggen
episodes.description: This is the sequel to Nero: Infiltration, this animation contains a flashback before Nero 1, which you should watch first. If you like Xiao style smooth animation you will love this movie.

episodes.title: Nero 3
episodes.creator: Triggen
episodes.description: Part 3 of the fight animation series that will rock your flash world. If the awesome action is not enough, then the sound track will be. Make sure you check out Part 1 and Part 2 first. Author comment: Now it's out folks, I've spent most of my holiday at this animation. I really hope you enjoy the last movie of the Nero Trilogy!

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: This is the first in a series to become known worldwide, across the net. This was originally done in movie form and later converted to flash.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 2
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: What did this wall ever do to him? If you like this at all you must see the next one.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 3
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: Yes this Xiao is "the one" - this is by far the most seen stick figure movie of all time. And with good reason, check it out.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 4
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: An awesome stick shoot em up game, and hey if you finish it, it's an awesome stick movie! Go go go!

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 5
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: This movie has it all, it's smooth, fast paced, funny, and well... "Xiao Sticks Fighting."

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 6
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: Another Xiao Xiao fighting game, push fast and win fast!

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 7
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: This is one of the best of the series, a great spy style movie with some awesome gun fight scenes and 3D effects.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 8
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: More 3D effects with matrix style slow motion, and let the car chase begin. Really clean movie!

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao 9
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: Double Dragon style fighting game, nice backgrounds, and a boss! Can you beat it? I know I can't.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao Beer Ad
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: People say sell out? I say wow! One of the coolest movies ever!

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao Beer Ad 2
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: Part two of Zhu's Heineken beer ad. Awesome 3D effects and action packed into a short but sweet movie.

episodes.title: Xiao Xiao City Plaza Ad
episodes.creator: Zhu
episodes.description: A great plug for a mall, some real smooth fighting, and some typical Matrix style kicking.

episodes.title: Killing Spree
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase comes across a gypsy... is it a dream or is it reality? He has one day to do what ever he wants... KILL!

episodes.title: Killing Spree 2
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase tests out his new power of immortality, what is he after at the military base?

episodes.title: Killing Spree 3
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase finds what he's looking for and puts it to good use. Where is he heading with it and why?

episodes.title: Killing Spree 4A
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase uses the tank against a certain building he despises and gets a little visit from a public enemy.

episodes.title: Killing Spree 4B
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase takes car of the cop and his partner... or so he thinks! Look out Jase here comes the SWAT!

episodes.title: Killing Spree 5
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Jase and Jim make it to the city but are interrupted by the swat team and a certain, "Rival Cop.... Barry"!

episodes.title: Killing Spree 6
episodes.creator: Master Samus
episodes.description: Finally after 2 years in production I've found time to complete this episode! "Revenge is a dish best served cold." A quick note... there's an EXTRA SCENE AFTER THE CREDITS! So watch all the way through.

episodes.title: Shock
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: You can't top this one! Extreme stick fighting animation taken to a new level by the master, Terkoiz. Get ready to be Shocked!

episodes.title: Shock 2
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: You can't top this one! Extreme stick fighting animation taken to a new level by the master, Terkoiz. Get ready to be Shocked!

episodes.title: Shock 3
episodes.creator: Terkoiz (Philips Lacanlale)
episodes.description: The final episode of the Shock series shows us what happens to Mr. Red when he arrives at work for his annual review! See if you can follow the true Mr. Green!

episodes.title: Shock More
episodes.creator: David "Geo" Borja
episodes.description: An amazing Shock tribute that you're going to love!

episodes.title: Shock Tribute
episodes.creator: Jcamelo
episodes.description: A tribute to Terkoiz' Shock series!

episodes.title: Slush Invaders Duel
episodes.creator: Gildedguy - Stick Page
episodes.description: Two prisoners Sthomas and Stucker are forced to fight like modern day gladiators in this amazingly detailed and action packed animated music video.
